From fc4144e7815b7747b6aba140d7a91da45ee9dd8c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Raju Rangoju <rajur@chelsio.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Feb 2019 17:40:53 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] cxgb4: Export sge_host_page_size to ulds

Export the sge_host_page_size field to ULDs via cxgb4_lld_info, so that
iw_cxgb4 can make use of this in calculating the correct qp/cq mask.

Fixes: 2391b0030e24 ("cxgb4: Remove SGE_HOST_PAGE_SIZE dependency on page size")
Signed-off-by: Raju Rangoju <rajur@chelsio.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@mellanox.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.c
index c041f44324db..b3654598a2d5 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.c
@@ -660,6 +660,7 @@ static void uld_init(struct adapter *adap, struct cxgb4_lld_info *lld)
 	lld->cclk_ps = 1000000000 / adap->params.vpd.cclk;
 	lld->udb_density = 1 << adap->params.sge.eq_qpp;
 	lld->ucq_density = 1 << adap->params.sge.iq_qpp;
+	lld->sge_host_page_size = 1 << (adap->params.sge.hps + 10);
 	lld->filt_mode = adap->params.tp.vlan_pri_map;
 	/* MODQ_REQ_MAP sets queues 0-3 to chan 0-3 */
 	for (i = 0; i < NCHAN; i++)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.h b/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.h
index 5fa9a2d5fc4b..21da34a4ca24 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.h
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb4/cxgb4_uld.h
@@ -336,6 +336,7 @@ struct cxgb4_lld_info {
 	unsigned int cclk_ps;                /* Core clock period in psec */
 	unsigned short udb_density;          /* # of user DB/page */
 	unsigned short ucq_density;          /* # of user CQs/page */
+	unsigned int sge_host_page_size;     /* SGE host page size */
 	unsigned short filt_mode;            /* filter optional components */
 	unsigned short tx_modq[NCHAN];       /* maps each tx channel to a */
 					     /* scheduler queue */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `cxgb4_uld.c`**
   - Added a line to initialize the `sge_host_page_size` field in the `cxgb4_lld_info` structure. The value is calculated as `1 << (adap->params.sge.hps + 10)`.

2. **File: `cxgb4_uld.h`**
   - Added a new member `sge_host_page_size` to the `cxgb4_lld_info` structure, defined as an `unsigned int`. This member is intended to store the SGE host page size.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `cxgb4_uld.c` directly utilizes the new member `sge_host_page_size` that was added in `cxgb4_uld.h`. By exporting the `sge_host_page_size` to the `cxgb4_lld_info` structure, it allows the ULDs (User-Level Drivers) to access this information, which is necessary for the `iw_cxgb4` component to correctly calculate the queue pair (qp) and completion queue (cq) mask. This change addresses the dependency on the page size that was previously removed, as indicated by the fix reference in the patch.

// Removed dependency on SGE_HOST_PAGE_SIZE

The removal of the dependency on `SGE_HOST_PAGE_SIZE` without exporting it to User-Level Drivers (ULDs) means that components like `iw_cxgb4` cannot access the necessary information to calculate the correct queue pair (qp) and completion queue (cq) mask, leading to potential misconfigurations or operational failures.

```c
lld->sge_host_page_size = 1 << (adap->params.sge.hps + 10);
```
